ctx.x: So, six of them left. I stayed with all the rest and we played this, this new club until I decided that we all should go home. But everybody decided to go home except one fellow, that was our
bass player Reginald Jones. He had met a girl the from Philippine Islands over there and he didn't want to come back home.

So I knew it was coming because when we'd go to these, you see nightclubs in China at that time, would stay open until 6, 7, 8 o'clock in the morning with the bands, you know, all the girls, the hostess. And whenever you go to a club you wouldn't come out until daylight hours.
